import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
root = pathlib.Path('products/research/csv-fixed-price-buyer-test')
source = root / 'buyer-wording-navigation.xml'
raw = source.read_bytes()
items = []
for entry in ET.fromstring(raw).findall('./channel/item'):
    title = (entry.findtext('title') or '').strip()
    url = (entry.findtext('link') or '').strip()
    description = entry.findtext('description') or ''
    text = f'{title} {description}'
    signals = {
        'buyer_request_wording': bool(re.search(r'looking for|need someone|seeking|request for|help wanted', text, re.I)),
        'reconciliation_scope': bool(re.search(r'reconcil|discrepanc|matching records|match invoices', text, re.I)),
        'paid_scope_wording': bool(re.search(r'fixed.price|budget|paid|compensation', text, re.I))
    }
    link = urlsplit(url)
    if link.scheme in ('https', 'http') and link.hostname:
        items.append({'title': title, 'url': url, 'signals': signals})
ranked = sorted(items, key=lambda item: sum(item['signals'].values()), reverse=True)
result = {'source': str(source), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'items': ranked, 'scope': 'Search excerpts are navigation. These phrase flags establish neither buyer identity, active scope, eligibility, compensation nor permission to respond. Verify any candidate in the original.'}
output = pathlib.Path('products/services/csv-fixed-price-buyer-test/buyer-wording-screen.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
